bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to judiciary; providing private attorneys with Minnesota Government Access to court records; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 484.94.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 484.94, is amended to read:

484.94 ATTORNEY ACCESS TO COURT RECORDS.
[+(a) +]An attorney who is admitted and licensed to practice law in the state may apply for a Minnesota Government Access account to access electronic court records and documents stored in the Minnesota Court Information System for cases in state district courts. [+Minnesota Government Access must provide an account with access rights upon application by an attorney who meets the requirements under this section. +]
[+(b) +]An attorney [+employed by a government agency and civil legal services +]shall [-be able to-] view and print case documents and information without cost to the attorney.[+ A private attorney shall pay a fee set by the judicial branch to view and print case documents and information. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to judiciary; providing private attorneys with Minnesota Government Access to court records; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 484.94.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 484.94, is amended to read:

484.94 ATTORNEY ACCESS TO COURT RECORDS.
(a) An attorney who is admitted and licensed to practice law in the state may apply for a Minnesota Government Access account to access electronic court records and documents stored in the Minnesota Court Information System for cases in state district courts. Minnesota Government Access must provide an account with access rights upon application by an attorney who meets the requirements under this section.
(b) An attorney employed by a government agency and civil legal services shall view and print case documents and information without cost to the attorney. A private attorney shall pay a fee set by the judicial branch to view and print case documents and information.
additions: Minnesota Government Access must provide an account with access rights upon application by an attorney who meets the requirements under this section.
employed by a government agency and civil legal services
A private attorney shall pay a fee set by the judicial branch to view and print case documents and information.
